summary: HUTCHMED filed a Form 6-K reporting that the NMPA granted conditional approval for ORPATHYS (savolitinib) to treat MET-amplified advanced gastric cancer in China. The approval is based on a Phase II study meeting its primary endpoint with a 32.3% objective response rate. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation transaction is involved. The filing is a routine regulatory update on a product approval.
